data.one_liner: Simple logger with optional caller info and custom formatting
data.what_it_does: Provides a lightweight API for logging messages with optional caller information and customizable output. It supports different log levels, custom prefixes, and can be configured to use dart:developer or print.
use_when: Need caller info for IDE navigation
avoid_when: Production environments requiring structured logging or integration with external log aggregators
Complex logging pipelines with filtering and routing
strengths: Optional caller info for IDE navigation
weaknesses: Limited to simple logging, no async stream or structured logs
No built‑in integration with external log services
Not suitable for high‑volume production logging
